criterion: One word names this setting in the config menu, its question, the help pages, the README, set, get, inspect and the error messages.
evidence: The word is effort. cli/config.go renames the setting-chooser row to 'effort\tEffort\tDefault effort level' and the config section to 'Model and effort'; cli/main.go's short help says 'Change model, effort, or connection' and the config help page says 'model and effort'; README.md:118, docs/guide.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md match; set/get/inspect/errors already said effort and are unchanged. tests/cli_messages_test.py::test_help_is_concise_truthful_and_read_only asserts no help page contains 'reasoning' and the config page says 'model and effort'; tests/docs_claims_test.py::test_docs_name_the_setting_effort_alone_issue_367 pins the README and guide phrases — both failed before the fix and passed after ('41 passed, 17 subtests passed' over cli_messages, cli_config_store, docs_claims, docs_anchor). Hermetic run with an isolated HOME: 'ccmorph --help' prints 'Change model, effort, or connection', 'ccmorph help config' prints 'model and effort', 'ccmorph get work effort' prints the saved level, 'ccmorph inspect work' shows 'effort     xhigh  profile default'.

criterion: A person who types the other word into set is told which word to use, not only shown a usage line.
evidence: cli/config.go's wrong-key branch answers a case-insensitive 'reasoning' with 'the setting is called effort, not reasoning' before the usage line. tests/cli_config_store_test.py::test_specialized_commands_refuse_without_changing_anything asserts that exact phrase on stderr for both 'set demo reasoning high' and 'get demo reasoning' — it failed before the fix (the stderr held only 'ccmorph: usage: ccmorph set [profile] [model|effort] [value]') and passed after, without changing any stored file. Hermetic run: 'ccmorph set work reasoning high' and 'ccmorph get work reasoning' both print 'ccmorph: the setting is called effort, not reasoning' plus the usage line, exit 2.

criterion: The level names in the picker and the values the commands accept match, or the picker shows both.
evidence: cli/menus.go's effortLabel now labels xhigh 'Extra high (xhigh)', naming the value beside the plain name; every other level's label already is its value. cli/menus_test.go::TestTheEffortPickerAndHelpNameTheConfLevels loops over profile.Efforts asserting each label contains its value — red before ('the picker labels "xhigh" as "Extra high", which does not name the value'), green after ('go test ./cli/' → ok). Headless no-TTY row dump shows 'xhigh\tExtra high (xhigh)\tEven more reasoning'. The pty assertions in tests/cli_picker_test.py ('Extra high (xhigh)', 'Effort — demo', 'Model and effort') could not run here: this sandbox refuses pty allocation, so they are left to CI.
